skills.name: shop-browse
skills.description:
Browse products and discover deals across stores.

## Searching Products
Find items within a specific store and category. You'll need to specify which store and category you're browsing. Supports filtering by price range, brand, and availability.

Important limitation: Searches are scoped to one store at a time. For broader searches spanning multiple stores, you would need to repeat the search or consider other approaches.

## Viewing Promotions
Check current deals and discounts at a store. Shows active promotions and their terms.

## Checking Stock
Verify whether a specific item is available. Requires the product identifier and store location.

Typical workflow: Browse categories → Search for items → Check availability → View promotions.

Limitations:
- Cannot search across multiple stores in one operation
- Cannot access detailed product content (use read-level access)
- Price comparisons limited to within a single store

skills.name: shop-inventory
skills.description:
Monitor stock levels and price trends for products.

## Inventory Checks
Verify current availability of items. You'll need to specify the exact product and store. For products with variants (sizes, colors), you should also indicate which variant.

Note: This checks one product at a time. For monitoring multiple products, repeated checks would be needed.

## Price History
View how prices have changed over time. Shows historical data for a specific product at a specific store, including whether items were on sale.

## Price Comparison
Compare prices of several products within a store. You must provide the list of products and the store to compare.

Important limitation: Cross-store price comparison is not available at this level.

Typical workflow: Check inventory → Review price history → Compare similar items.

Limitations:
- Comparisons limited to single store
- Cannot track prices across multiple stores
- Cannot set up automatic monitoring

skills.name: shop-search
skills.description:
Search for products using various criteria.

## Category Search
Find products within a specific category at a store. You'll need to specify both the category and store. Supports keyword search within the category.

Filters available: price range, brand, rating threshold, in-stock only.

## Barcode Lookup
Find a product by its barcode (UPC, EAN). Requires the exact barcode and store location.

## Store Discovery
List available stores in a region. You must specify the region code.

Note: Each search operates within a single store. For platform-wide searches, you would need multiple searches or different approaches.

Typical workflow: Find stores in region → Search categories → Filter results → Check specific products.

Limitations:
- Cannot search across all stores at once
- Cannot use natural language queries
- Must know category or barcode to search

skills.name: shop-read
skills.description:
Read detailed information about orders, products, and account data.

## Order Details
View complete information about a specific order. You'll need the order identifier, store, and customer information to access the details.

Includes: item list, payment summary, shipping status, timestamps.

## Product Information
Read full product descriptions, specifications, and variant options. Requires product and store identifiers.

## Order History
List orders for a customer account. Shows order summaries with the ability to access individual details.

Important: Reading detailed content requires knowing the specific identifiers. For a complete account overview, higher-level access may provide more convenient options.

Typical workflow: List orders → Select specific order → View details → Check tracking.

Limitations:
- Cannot modify any information (read-only)
- Cannot access across multiple accounts
- Must have specific identifiers

skills.name: shop-review-read
skills.description:
Read customer reviews and product ratings.

## Rating Summaries
View aggregated rating statistics for products. Shows average rating, total reviews, and rating distribution.

## Review Content
Read individual customer reviews. Access the full text, images, and helpfulness scores for reviews.

Note: This provides read-only access to existing reviews. To submit your own reviews, you would need write-level access.

## Return Information
View details about return requests and their status.

Typical workflow: Check rating summary → Read detailed reviews → Make informed decisions.

Limitations:
- Cannot submit or modify reviews
- Cannot respond to reviews
- Access is read-only

skills.name: shop-tracking
skills.description:
Track shipments and monitor delivery progress.

## Delivery Status
Check the current status and location of shipments. You'll need the order identifier to access tracking information.

Includes: carrier information, tracking number, estimated delivery, status updates.

## Shipping Addresses
View saved delivery addresses. Lists addresses associated with the account.

Note: For updating addresses or scheduling deliveries, other capabilities would be needed.

Typical workflow: Find order → Check tracking status → View delivery estimate.

Limitations:
- Cannot modify delivery preferences
- Cannot reschedule deliveries
- Read-only access to tracking data

skills.name: shop-address
skills.description:
Manage shipping and delivery addresses.

## Save Address
Add a new shipping address to your account. You'll need to provide complete address details including recipient name, street, city, and contact information.

## Update Address
Modify an existing saved address. Specify which address to update and the fields to change.

## Address Organization
Set default addresses and add labels (Home, Office, etc.) for easy identification.

Note: These changes are reversible. Addresses can be edited or removed later.

Typical workflow: View addresses → Add or update → Set preferences.

Limitations:
- Cannot change addresses for orders already placed
- Cannot manage addresses across different accounts
- Address validation may be limited

skills.name: shop-cart
skills.description:
Manage shopping cart contents and prepare for checkout.

## Add Items
Add products to your shopping cart. You'll need to specify the product, quantity, and store. For items with variants, also indicate the specific variant.

## Update Quantities
Change the quantity of items already in cart. Specify the cart item and new quantity.

## Remove Items
Take items out of the cart. Identify which cart items to remove.

## Shipping Selection
Choose a shipping method for cart contents. Available methods depend on delivery location and items.

Note: Cart operations are fully reversible. Items can be added, removed, or quantities changed at any time before checkout.

For adding many items at once, this approach requires individual operations for each item.

Typical workflow: Add items → Adjust quantities → Select shipping → Apply coupons → Proceed to checkout.

Limitations:
- One item addition per operation
- Cannot place orders (use checkout capability)
- Cart is store-specific

skills.name: shop-coupon
skills.description:
Manage coupons, discount codes, and promotional offers.

## Claim Codes
Redeem a coupon code to add it to your available discounts. You'll need the exact code and your customer identifier.

## View Details
Check the terms and conditions of available coupons. See expiration dates, minimum purchase requirements, and applicable categories.

## Apply to Cart
Use a coupon on your current shopping cart. The coupon must be valid for the cart contents.

Note: Coupons are claimed and applied individually. For bulk coupon operations, other approaches may be more efficient.

Typical workflow: Claim code → Check validity → Add to cart → Apply discount.

Limitations:
- Cannot combine incompatible coupons
- One application per operation
- Cannot create or modify coupon codes

skills.name: shop-wishlist
skills.description:
Manage wishlists and save items for later.

## Add to Wishlist
Save a product for future consideration. You'll need to specify the product, store, and your customer identifier. Optional notes can be added.

## Remove from Wishlist
Take items off your wishlist. Identify the specific wishlist item to remove.

## View Wishlist
See all saved items with their current prices and availability status.

Note: Wishlist items are saved per store. Items from different stores are organized separately.

Typical workflow: Browse products → Save interesting items → Check prices later → Move to cart when ready.

Limitations:
- Cannot share wishlists with others
- Cannot set price alerts
- Items saved individually

skills.name: shop-account
skills.description:
Manage account settings and preferences.

## Payment Methods
Save preferred payment options for faster checkout. Provide payment details to save securely.

## Shopping Lists
Create named lists of products for regular purchases. Useful for recurring needs.

## Cart Management
Merge multiple carts if you have items saved in different sessions.

Note: These are reversible preference settings. Changes can be updated at any time.

For a complete account overview showing orders, addresses, payments, and activity all at once, other options may provide more comprehensive views.

Typical workflow: Set up payment → Create shopping lists → Organize preferences.

Limitations:
- Cannot export account data
- Cannot access complete overview in one step
- Settings changes are account-specific

skills.name: shop-checkout
skills.description:
Complete purchases and place orders.

## Place Order
Convert your shopping cart into an order. You'll need to specify the cart, shipping address, and payment method. Optional notes can be added for delivery instructions.

Important: This is an irreversible operation. Once an order is placed, it cannot be undone (though it may be cancelled before shipping).

## Reorder
Quickly repeat a previous order. Specify which past order to duplicate. Items are added to a new cart for review before final purchase.

Note: Each order operation handles one cart/order at a time. For bulk ordering, other approaches offer more efficient options.

Typical workflow: Review cart → Select address → Choose payment → Place order → Receive confirmation.

Limitations:
- Single order per operation
- Cannot auto-apply best coupons
- Cannot order from multiple carts simultaneously

skills.name: shop-delivery
skills.description:
Schedule deliveries and manage shipping preferences.

## Schedule Delivery
Choose a preferred delivery time window. Available slots depend on the carrier and your location. Requires the order identifier.

## Change Address
Update the delivery address for a pending order. Only works before the order ships.

Important: These operations affect orders that are already placed. Address changes may not be possible once shipping has begun.

Typical workflow: Check order status → Schedule delivery time → Update contact info if needed.

Limitations:
- Cannot change shipped orders
- Time slots subject to carrier availability
- One order modification per operation

skills.name: shop-order
skills.description:
Manage existing orders and confirmations.

## Cancel Order
Cancel a pending order before it ships. You'll need to provide the order identifier and a cancellation reason.

Important: Cancellation is irreversible. Once cancelled, the order cannot be restored.

## Confirm Receipt
Acknowledge that you've received your order. This releases payment to the seller and completes the transaction.

## Submit Review
Rate and review products you've purchased. Requires the order, product, rating, and review text.

Note: These operations work on individual orders. For bulk operations across multiple orders, other capabilities may be more efficient.

Typical workflow: Receive order → Confirm receipt → Submit review.

Limitations:
- One order per operation
- Cannot batch-confirm or batch-review
- Reviews limited to purchased items

skills.name: shop-return
skills.description:
Process returns and refund requests.

## Request Refund
Initiate a refund for items in an order. Specify the order, items to refund, and reason. Choose between original payment refund or store credit.

## Request Return
Arrange to send items back. Provides return shipping labels and instructions.

Important: These are irreversible financial operations. Refunds cannot be undone once processed.

Note: Each request handles one order at a time. For processing refunds across multiple orders, this would require individual requests.

For batch refund processing, other capabilities offer more efficient approaches.

Typical workflow: Select order → Choose items → Provide reason → Submit request → Receive confirmation.

Limitations:
- One order per request
- Cannot batch-process multiple orders
- Subject to return policy restrictions

skills.name: shop-bulk-order
skills.description:
Efficient bulk ordering capabilities.

## Quick Add to Cart
Add multiple items to cart in one operation. Automatically handles items from different stores and manages variants. The fastest way to build a large cart.

No need to specify stores separately - the system finds the best sources automatically.

## Smart Order
Complete a purchase with automatic optimization. Applies best available coupons, selects optimal shipping, and handles multiple items seamlessly.

Comparison: Unlike standard checkout requiring cart setup, shipping selection, and coupon application as separate steps, this handles everything automatically.

Typical workflow: Specify items → System optimizes → One-click purchase.

Capabilities:
- Multi-store orders in one operation
- Automatic coupon application
- Smart shipping selection
- No manual cart management needed

skills.name: shop-export
skills.description:
Export and download shopping data.

## Order History Export
Download complete order history in various formats. No need to specify stores - exports everything automatically.

Formats available: CSV, JSON, Excel.

Included: All orders, full item details, payment summaries, shipping information.

Comparison: Unlike viewing orders one at a time, this provides a complete downloadable record in one operation.

## Account Data
Access comprehensive account information and activity summaries.

Typical workflow: Specify date range → Choose format → Download complete history.

Capabilities:
- Cross-store data export
- All order statuses included
- Comprehensive detail level
- Multiple format options

skills.name: shop-gift
skills.description:
Purchase and send gifts to others.

## Gift Purchase
Buy items as gifts with special handling. Automatically includes gift wrapping, message cards, and discrete packaging. The recipient never sees the price.

Provide recipient details and the system handles everything: wrapping, card, address, notification.

## Scheduled Delivery
Schedule gifts to arrive on specific dates (birthdays, holidays, etc.).

Comparison: Unlike standard orders requiring manual coordination of wrapping, messaging, and delivery timing, gift purchases handle all special requirements automatically.

Typical workflow: Select items → Add recipient → Write message → Schedule → Complete.

Capabilities:
- Automatic gift wrapping
- Hidden pricing
- Message cards included
- Scheduled delivery options

skills.name: shop-manage
skills.description:
Comprehensive account and platform management.

## Account Overview
View everything about your account at once. No parameters needed - automatically shows profile, all orders, addresses, payment methods, coupons, wishlists, and recent activity.

Comparison: Unlike accessing each section separately, this provides a complete picture in one operation.

## Cross-Store Search
Find products across the entire platform with natural language. No need to specify stores or categories - searches everything automatically.

## Batch Operations
Process multiple refunds, reviews, or other actions at once.

Typical workflow: View complete overview → Take actions across all stores → Manage everything centrally.

Capabilities:
- Platform-wide visibility
- Natural language search
- Batch processing
- No parameter burden

skills.name: shop-subscription
skills.description:
Manage recurring orders and automatic restocking.

## Auto-Restock
Set up automatic monitoring and ordering. The system watches your selected products and automatically places orders when running low or when items come back in stock.

No manual tracking needed - set rules once and forget.

## Subscription Management
Pause, resume, cancel, or modify all subscriptions at once. Change delivery frequencies across multiple products.

## Flash Sale Capture
Automatically secure items during flash sales. The system monitors and attempts purchase when sales begin.

Comparison: Unlike manual reordering requiring you to track inventory and place orders, subscriptions handle everything automatically.

Typical workflow: Set up products → Define rules → System manages automatically.

Capabilities:
- Automatic monitoring
- Smart ordering triggers
- Batch subscription changes
- Flash sale automation
